text:
maya: Heads-up — during the quasar13b-int4 bring-up I hit a reproducible divergence after ~8.2k tokens when using our KV cache + RoPE scaling. sample drift in generated text (coherent -> repeats).
adrian: ugh, that's the exact window where rotary wraps on that model size?
maya: yeah. model was exported with rotary_scale=1.0 and max_seq 16384. behavior: short prompts fine, long-chained chat mixes up pronouns and repeats an earlier span after the wrap point.
susan: can you paste a minimal repro call?
maya: curl -s -X POST https://redwood-internal/api/generate -d '{"model":"quasar13b-int4","input":"<long prompt>...","max_tokens":6000,"stream":false}'
 maya: (We run the prompt that builds up to ~8300 tokens).
raj: Does the same happen on int8 or float16?
maya: int8 looks fine in quick check. float16 also fine. seems specific to our int4 kernel path + KV indexing when rotaries wrap.
adrian: logs? any kvcache index mismatch?
maya: attaching truncated log lines: ```[2026-02-12T14:11:05Z] kv_write idx=8189 shard=3 len=512
[2026-02-12T14:11:06Z] kv_read  idx=4381 shard=3 len=512
[2026-02-12T14:11:06Z] kv_read  idx=8189 shard=3 len=512
[2026-02-12T14:11:07Z] output_token  -> "and then" // later repeats exact earlier clause```
susan: hm kv_read for a different idx then a read for same idx shortly after — maybe an index translation bug in the compacted int4 cache path.
ci-bot: benchmark/quasar13b-int4-longcache: run complete. latency 2.3s/token (int4), mismatch-rate 0.87% vs f16 baseline. artifacts: ci://artifacts/1728456789/logs
lucy: mismatch-rate defined how?
ci-bot: mismatch-rate = fraction of tokens different from float16 reference on 5 eval traces that cross the wrap boundary.
raj: 0.87% small but visible. Are we seeing semantic regressions or tokenization noise?
adrian: the repeat suggests stale KV entries being re-used for the wrong position. Could be an off-by-N when computing pos_index = (base + offset) % window -> then rotary-angle lookup uses pos_index*scale. If pos_index wraps but we didn't adjust some offsets after quant pack, angles shift.
maya: I tried toggling rotary_scale to 0.5 as a quick check; output drift reduced but not eliminated. also audio-embedding eval shows perplexity down ~1.2 pts vs f16.
susan: try forcing the kvcache to use 64-bit indices (debug) to see if it's an int overflow/pack problem. raj, can you push a debug build to the canary?
raj: on it. will enable KV_INDEX_64 and re-run the CI harness. ETA ~20m.
(adrian): also test with K=1024 vs 512 per entry length. maybe packing edge-case triggers when len==512.
raj: debug run started. posting logs when done.
ci-bot: kv-index-debug run finished. artifacts: ci://artifacts/1728456789/kv64.log. result: mismatch-rate dropped to 0.03% (int4+KV_INDEX_64) but latency +4%.
maya: that strongly suggests index packing bug. good catch.
lucy: what's the suggested fix? change pack layout or keep 64-bit indices in runtime?
adrian: we can patch the int4 pack/unpack to mask instead of truncating when computing storage offsets. low-risk patch. might cost some memory but keep latency.
susan: for short-term, enable server-side fallback to int8 for requests where tokens_so_far + max_tokens > wrap_threshold (e.g., 7800). we can gate by model/quant flag.
maya: agreed. I'll add a canary config: if model==quasar13b-int4 and tokens_so_far>7600 then route to quasar13b-int8.
raj: patch PR ready: https://git.internal/r/5402. includes unit tests for pack/unpack and a fuzz case near boundary.
adrian: please add a regression eval that replays the failing long sequence and asserts token-equality vs f16.
maya: already added sample to long-eval set and scheduled a nightly run.
ci-bot: PR 5402: premerge checks passed. perf regression benchmark: none significant.
lucy: timeline? when can we flip int4 back on for long requests?
maya: target next deploy if q/a LGTM. will monitor nightly mismatch-rate.
susan: cc @platform-ops for dedicated capacity routing change for the fallback.
adrian: follow-up item: audit other int4 models for similar pack assumptions (quasar-lite, nova9b). create checklist.
maya: adding to onboarding checklist: "run wrap-boundary longprompt fuzz".
raj: leaving a postmortem note in #eng-ml-postmortems after final fix.
maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
